cells.value:
# QuestDB · Operational overview
WAL telemetry: **109** = WAL committed, **103** = commit→apply-start delay, **105** = data applied; latency is **ms**. A single apply operation can finish several transactions: 105 records the **same batch duration on each applied transaction**, so event p95 is transaction-weighted, not a percentile of independent batch executions. WAL flow compares enqueued/applied/committed rows; equal lines mean they moved together at this chart's resolution, not that lag is impossible. **WAL backlog** uses sequencer minus writer transaction gauges. Physical row rewrites/s tracks write work, not unique ingested rows. The WAL ingress-mix chart shows each base table's percentage of event-109 committed rows, not a percentage of all database activity. RSS is resident; `memory_mem_used` includes virtual mappings and must not be read as RSS. Memory gauges update roughly every 60s. The counter-reset marker indicates a possible restart or metric reset, not an outage diagnosis. Newest per-minute count buckets may be partial. QWP egress has no traffic on this demo instance, so its empty panel was removed.
cells.name: Monitoring guide

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(cpu_questdb_percent) AS questdb_cpu_pct, max(cpu_questdb_percent) AS peak_cpu_pct, avg(cpu_box_percent) AS host_cpu_pct, 100.0*avg(memory_jvm_total-memory_jvm_free)/avg(memory_jvm_max) AS jvm_heap_used_pct FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-1h..$now' SAMPLE BY 30s
cells.name: Capacity trend · CPU & JVM heap (%)

cells.value: WITH top AS (SELECT tableId, approx_percentile(latency,0.95) AS p95 FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' WHERE created IN '$now-5m..$now' AND event=105 GROUP BY tableId ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT s.created AS ts, t.table_name, approx_percentile(s.latency,0.95) AS latency_p95 FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' s JOIN top x ON s.tableId=x.tableId JOIN tables() t ON s.tableId=t.id WHERE s.created IN '$now-2h..$now' AND s.event=105 AND s.latency>=0 SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL data-apply batch duration · p95 ms by hot table

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(cpu_questdb_percent) AS questdb_pct, avg(cpu_box_percent) AS host_pct FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: CPU · QuestDB vs host (%)

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(memory_rss)/1073741824.0 AS rss_avg_gib, max(memory_rss)/1073741824.0 AS rss_peak_gib FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Resident memory · RSS average & peak (GiB)

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(memory_jvm_total-memory_jvm_free)/1073741824.0 AS used_gib, avg(memory_jvm_total)/1073741824.0 AS committed_gib FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: JVM heap · used vs committed (GiB)

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(memory_tag_MMAP_TABLE_READER)/1048576.0 AS mapped_readers_mib, avg(memory_tag_MMAP_TABLE_WRITER)/1048576.0 AS mapped_writers_mib FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m; SELECT ts, avg(memory_tag_NATIVE_ILP_RSS)/1048576.0 AS native_ilp_mib, avg(memory_tag_NATIVE_O3)/1048576.0 AS native_o3_mib FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Memory attribution over time · mapped / native (MiB)

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, committed_rows-lag(committed_rows) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS committed_d, wal_written_rows-lag(wal_written_rows) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS wal_d, wal_apply_written_rows-lag(wal_apply_written_rows) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS apply_d, (ts-lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts))/1000000.0 AS seconds FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN committed_d>=0 THEN committed_d ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS table_committed_rows_sec, sum(CASE WHEN wal_d>=0 THEN wal_d ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS wal_enqueued_rows_sec, sum(CASE WHEN apply_d>=0 THEN apply_d ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS wal_applied_rows_sec FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL flow · enqueued, applied & table committed rows/s

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, wal_apply_physically_written_rows-lag(wal_apply_physically_written_rows) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS physical_d, (ts-lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts))/1000000.0 AS seconds FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN physical_d>=0 THEN physical_d ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS physical_rows_sec FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL apply · physical row rewrites/s

cells.value: SELECT created AS ts, approx_percentile(latency,0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile(latency,0.95) AS p95, approx_percentile(latency,0.99) AS p99 FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' WHERE created IN '$now-2h..$now' AND event=105 AND latency>=0 SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL data-apply batch duration · p50/p95/p99 ms

cells.value: SELECT s.created AS ts, sum(CASE WHEN s.event=109 AND s.rowCount>0 THEN s.rowCount ELSE 0 END) AS wal_committed_rows, sum(CASE WHEN s.event=105 AND s.rowCount>0 THEN s.rowCount ELSE 0 END) AS data_applied_rows FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' s JOIN tables() t ON s.tableId=t.id WHERE s.created IN '$now-2h..$now' AND s.event IN (109,105) AND NOT t.matView SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL base tables · committed (109) vs applied (105) rows/min

cells.value: SELECT s.created AS ts, t.table_name, approx_percentile(s.latency,0.95) AS commit_to_apply_p95_ms FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' s JOIN tables() t ON s.tableId=t.id WHERE s.created IN '$now-2h..$now' AND s.event=103 AND s.latency>=0 AND NOT t.matView SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL commit → apply-start delay · p95 ms by base table

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, query_error_counter-lag(query_error_counter) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS query_d, pg_wire_errors-lag(pg_wire_errors) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS pg_d, unhandled_errors-lag(unhandled_errors) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS unhandled_d, reader_leak_counter-lag(reader_leak_counter) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS leak_d, rollbacks-lag(rollbacks) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS rollback_d FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN query_d>=0 THEN query_d ELSE 0 END) AS query_errors, sum(CASE WHEN pg_d>=0 THEN pg_d ELSE 0 END) AS pg_errors, sum(CASE WHEN unhandled_d>=0 THEN unhandled_d ELSE 0 END) AS unhandled, sum(CASE WHEN leak_d>=0 THEN leak_d ELSE 0 END) AS reader_leaks, sum(CASE WHEN rollback_d>=0 THEN rollback_d ELSE 0 END) AS rollbacks FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Faults & rollbacks · deltas/min

cells.value: SELECT ts, max(worker_pool_fiber_queued__shared_query) AS query_queued_peak, max(worker_pool_fiber_queued__shared_network) AS network_queued_peak, max(worker_pool_fiber_queued__mat_view_refresh) AS mv_queued_peak FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Worker queues · peak depth per minute

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, json_queries_completed-lag(json_queries_completed) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS http_d, pg_wire_queries_completed-lag(pg_wire_queries_completed) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS pg_d, (ts-lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts))/1000000.0 AS seconds FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN http_d>=0 THEN http_d ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS http_per_sec, sum(CASE WHEN pg_d>=0 THEN pg_d ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS pg_per_sec FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Queries completed · HTTP & PG / second

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, json_queries_cache_hits-lag(json_queries_cache_hits) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS hits, json_queries_cache_misses-lag(json_queries_cache_misses) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS misses, pg_wire_select_cache_hits-lag(pg_wire_select_cache_hits) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS pg_hits, pg_wire_select_cache_misses-lag(pg_wire_select_cache_misses) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS pg_misses FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now'), b AS (SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN hits>=0 THEN hits ELSE 0 END) AS h, sum(CASE WHEN misses>=0 THEN misses ELSE 0 END) AS m, sum(CASE WHEN pg_hits>=0 THEN pg_hits ELSE 0 END) AS ph, sum(CASE WHEN pg_misses>=0 THEN pg_misses ELSE 0 END) AS pm FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m) SELECT ts, CASE WHEN h+m>0 THEN 100.0*h/(h+m) ELSE null END AS http_hit_pct, CASE WHEN ph+pm>0 THEN 100.0*ph/(ph+pm) ELSE null END AS pg_hit_pct FROM b
cells.name: Query cache efficiency · HTTP & PG hit rate (%)

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(http_connections) AS http, avg(json_queries_connections) AS http_query, avg(pg_wire_connections) AS pg_wire, avg(line_tcp_connections) AS ilp_tcp, avg(line_http_connections) AS ilp_http, avg(qwp_egress_connections) AS qwp_egress FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Connection counts · HTTP, PG, ILP & QWP

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, line_tcp_recv_bytes-lag(line_tcp_recv_bytes) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS tcp_d, line_http_recv_bytes-lag(line_http_recv_bytes) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS http_d, (ts-lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts))/1000000.0 AS seconds FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN tcp_d>=0 THEN tcp_d ELSE 0 END)/(1048576.0*nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0)) AS tcp_mib_sec, sum(CASE WHEN http_d>=0 THEN http_d ELSE 0 END)/(1048576.0*nullif(sum(CASE WHEN seconds>0 THEN seconds ELSE 0 END),0)) AS http_mib_sec FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: ILP ingress · TCP & HTTP (MiB/s)

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, jvm_minor_gc_time-lag(jvm_minor_gc_time) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS minor_d, jvm_major_gc_time-lag(jvm_major_gc_time) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS major_d FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN minor_d>=0 THEN minor_d ELSE 0 END) AS minor_gc_ms, sum(CASE WHEN major_d>=0 THEN major_d ELSE 0 END) AS major_gc_ms FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: JVM GC pause time · minor & major (ms/min)

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, jvm_minor_gc_count-lag(jvm_minor_gc_count) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS minor_d, jvm_major_gc_count-lag(jvm_major_gc_count) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS major_d FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, sum(CASE WHEN minor_d >= 0 THEN minor_d ELSE 0 END) AS minor_gc, sum(CASE WHEN major_d >= 0 THEN major_d ELSE 0 END) AS major_gc FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: GC events · minor & major / min

cells.value: SELECT ts, max(CASE WHEN wal_apply_seq_txn>=wal_apply_writer_txn THEN wal_apply_seq_txn-wal_apply_writer_txn ELSE 0 END) AS pending_txns, max(suspended_tables) AS suspended_tables FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: WAL backlog · pending transactions & suspended tables

cells.value: WITH d AS (SELECT ts, commits, lag(commits) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_commits, wal_written_rows, lag(wal_written_rows) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_wal FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now') SELECT ts, max(CASE WHEN commits<prev_commits OR wal_written_rows<prev_wal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS counter_reset FROM d SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Metric counter resets · restart indicator (0/1)

cells.value: SELECT s.created AS ts, t.table_name, 1.0*sum(CASE WHEN s.physicalRowCount>=0 THEN s.physicalRowCount ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN s.rowCount>0 THEN s.rowCount ELSE 0 END),0) AS physical_rows_per_logical_row FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' s JOIN tables() t ON s.tableId=t.id WHERE s.created IN '$now-6h..$now' AND s.event=105 AND NOT t.matView SAMPLE BY 5m
cells.name: WAL physical/logical write amplification · × by base table

cells.value: SELECT ts, avg(memory_mem_used)/1073741824.0 AS tracked_including_mmaps_gib FROM 'sys.metrics' WHERE ts IN '$now-6h..$now' SAMPLE BY 1m
cells.name: Tracked allocations · includes mappings (GiB)

cells.value: WITH per_table AS (SELECT created AS ts, tableId, sum(rowCount) AS rows FROM 'sys.telemetry_wal' WHERE created IN '$now-6h..$now' AND event=109 AND rowCount>0 SAMPLE BY 1m), base AS (SELECT p.ts, t.table_name, p.rows FROM per_table p JOIN tables() t ON p.tableId=t.id WHERE NOT t.matView) SELECT ts, table_name, 100.0*rows/sum(rows) OVER (PARTITION BY ts) AS share_pct FROM base
cells.name: WAL ingress mix · committed-row share by base table (%)
